description: This file implements mechanisms for handling corrupt objects in etcd storage within the Kubernetes API server, including wrapping decoders and transformers to detect corrupt objects, aggregating errors, and facilitating unsafe deletion of such objects.

classes.name: corruptObjErrAggregator
classes.description: Aggregates errors encountered during listing objects, specifically handling corrupt object errors and abort errors.

classes.name: corruptObjectDeleter
classes.description: Facilitates unsafe deletion of corrupt objects in etcd storage.

classes.name: corruptObjErrorInterpretingDecoder
classes.description: Wraps a decoder to interpret errors as corrupt object errors.

classes.name: corruptObjErrorInterpretingTransformer
classes.description: Wraps a transformer to interpret errors as corrupt object errors.

classes.name: corruptObjectError
classes.description: Represents errors related to corrupt objects, such as undecodable data or untransformable data.

classes.name: aggregatedStorageError
classes.description: Holds an aggregated list of storage errors, especially related to corrupt objects.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves an object by key, wrapping errors as corrupt object errors if applicable.

methods.name: GetList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of objects, handling aggregated corrupt object errors.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes data into an object, wrapping errors as corrupt object errors.

methods.name: DecodeListItem
methods.description: Decodes list item data into an object, wrapping errors as corrupt object errors.

methods.name: TransformFromStorage
methods.description: Transforms data from storage, wrapping errors as corrupt object errors.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the corruptObjectError.

methods.name: Unwrap
methods.description: Unwraps the underlying error from corruptObjectError.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Formats the aggregated storage error message.

methods.name: NewAPIStatusError
methods.description: Creates an API status error from the aggregated errors.
